methodological_rigor.justification: The study integrates multimodal human data (snRNA+ATAC multiome on n=4; scRNA-seq harmonized across 22 patients and 30,206 immune cells; methylation EPIC on 508 Northwestern tumors plus publicly available 904; harmonized RNA-seq of 584 meningiomas), ex vivo patient cytotoxicity (n=9 patients; n=3 for CD45 depletion and death-pathway rescue panels), multiple cell lines (IOMM-LEE, CH157-MN, MGS1), and flank/orthotopic/immunocompetent MGS1 models. Mechanism is probed with GSDMD Western blots, EM imaging, bone-marrow-derived macrophages from MyD88 and Tmem173gt knockout strains, and Luminex multiplex cytokines. A PASS-based sample-size calculation (10 mice/arm for HR 0.5) is reported. Limitations include modest patient n for multiome/ex vivo assays, single STING agonist (8803) tested, and limited formal multiplicity correction across many exploratory analyses.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Preclinical/translational work on cells, patient-derived ex vivo specimens, and mouse models, mapping to Oxford LoE 5. Clinical relevance is high: meningiomas have no established systemic therapy and two ICB trials showed limited benefit, making the identification of STING as a targetable locus across both neoplastic and myeloid compartments directly pertinent. The authors explicitly propose a clinical trial of 8803 in surgically refractory meningiomas.

reporting_quality.justification: ARRIVE applies for the animal arm. IACUC approval, housing parameters (12:12 light, 18-23 C, 40-60% humidity), humane endpoints (>20% weight loss, ulceration, neurologic symptoms), randomization, both sexes used, and an explicit power calculation are all reported. IRB protocols (STU00211542, STU00214485) cover human samples. A Nature Portfolio Reporting Summary is referenced. Blinding is noted as not required for survival endpoints. Data availability: uses public datasets (GSE230389, TCGA) and references harmonized cohorts; accession numbers for newly generated multiome and murine scRNA-seq are not clearly cited in the methods excerpt.

novelty_literature.justification: The work is the first to systematically demonstrate STING promoter hypomethylation and open chromatin in meningioma neoplastic cells (unlike gliomas where STING is largely closed in tumor cells), and to show direct 8803-induced tumor cytotoxicity via GSDMD pore formation/pyroptosis in solid CNS tumors. The synergy between direct tumor-cell death and myeloid-mediated collagen remodeling (LAIR-1/collagen axis) is a novel integration. Individual elements (STING agonism in brain tumors, pyroptosis in cancer) have precedent, but the meningioma-specific dual mechanism is new.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is well structured with a clear narrative arc from immune microenvironment characterization to mechanism to preclinical efficacy. Methods are extensively detailed and figure legends are embedded in the results text (typical of the Nature Portfolio format). Minor issues include some figure-legend prose appearing inline with results (slightly reducing readability) and occasional typos ('>08.5' in CONICSmat threshold).

key_strengths: Integrated multi-modal profiling (snRNA+ATAC, methylation on 508 tumors, harmonized RNA-seq on 584) establishes meningioma-specific STING epigenetic activation versus gliomas
Direct ex vivo patient-derived demonstration that 8803 is tumor-cytotoxic through GSDMD-dependent pyroptosis, validated by EM and pharmacologic death-pathway inhibitors
Immunocompetent orthotopic MGS1 model shows survival benefit and TME remodeling; bone-marrow-derived macrophages from Tmem173gt and MyD88 knockouts provide genetic causality
Explicit preclinical power calculation (PASS: 10 mice/arm, HR 0.5) and both sexes included in mouse studies
key_concerns: Patient n for multiome (n=4) and ex vivo assays (n=9, with n=3 subsets) is modest given meningioma grade heterogeneity
Only one STING agonist (8803) is tested; dose-response and comparator agonists (e.g., ADU-S100) are not presented
Accession numbers for newly generated multiome and murine scRNA-seq data are not clearly referenced in the methods
Minor typographical inconsistencies (e.g., CONICSmat threshold '>08.5') suggest a copy-edit pass is needed
chief_reviewer.rationale: A mechanistically coherent, clinically motivated preclinical package positioning 8803 for first-in-disease trials in meningioma; top-tier plausible with minor revisions around accessions and n.
